question: Should OpenClaw support Android/Termux as a Gateway host, and if so which supported mode owns service lifecycle, auth exposure, dashboard/network access, updates, and real-device validation?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the acceptable product shape changes platform support, security posture, and Android lifecycle guarantees beyond a narrow code fix.

options.title: Design scoped Android Gateway hosting
options.body: Define one supported Android/Termux hosting mode with service lifecycle, security, docs, and real-device validation requirements before implementation.

options.title: Keep Android node-only
options.body: Explicitly document that Android remains a companion node and point mobile-only users to endorsed remote-host or external alternatives.

options.title: Route to external Android stack
options.body: Treat AndroidForClaw-style full-device Gateway hosting as external ecosystem work unless a missing core API is identified.

recommendation.title: Design scoped Android Gateway hosting
recommendation.body: Define one supported Android/Termux hosting mode with service lifecycle, security, docs, and real-device validation requirements before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses project direction, Gateway service support, Android product scope, and security posture.
